main_text.p: Nunc 119 divido per 32, & proveniunt 3, & fractions 2 0 over 3 2 quæ per 4 in hanc fractionem ducuntur: 5/8
main_text.head: De Subtractione Fractionum.
main_text.p: In Subtractione Fractionū perinde procedītur ac in Additione, nisi quòd peracta multiplicatione numerus minor à majori subducatur, & qui remanet, si fieri potest per multiplicatum Denominatorem dividatur.
Duæ quintæ à tribus quartis quot remanent? 2/5 X 3/4 1 5/8 7/20
Thalerus & tres septimę à quatuor Thaleris & quinq; nonis, quot remanent? 1 3/7 4 5/9 197 287 90 10/7 X 41/9
main_text.head: De Multiplicatione Fractionum.
main_text.p: Hic Numeratorem per alterū multiplico, multiplicatum seorsim noto: Deinde Denominatorem per alterum multiplicatum subnoto: Et si fieri potest per eum dividoʃin minus, linea interjecta fit fractio. 3/7 X 5/8 15/56

page.notes: The fraction and calculation sketches are reproduced approximately from the scan; the exact layout of small stacked fractions is uncertain. The word "potest" and "ʃin" in the last paragraph are doubtful readings (the printed text reads "minus" after a dividing stroke). The fraction layouts and the figures 197, 287, 90 are set out as on the page and may be partly misread. Page is slightly damaged at the right edge, so line ends may be incomplete.
